data.one_liner: Gradient borders for Flutter inputs and containers
data.what_it_does: Provides border classes that use gradients instead of solid colors for containers and text field input decorations. Supports custom widths, border radius, stroke alignment, and box shapes.
use_when: You need custom gradient box borders on containers
You want gradient outlines or underlines for input decorations
avoid_when: You only need standard solid-colored borders
strengths: Easy to use with standard Flutter widgets
Supports both container box borders and text field input borders
data.minimal_example:
Container(
  width: 100,
  height: 100,
  decoration: BoxDecoration(
    border: const GradientBoxBorder(
      gradient: LinearGradient(colors: [Colors.blue, Colors.red]),
      width: 4,
    ),
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)
  ),
)
